name: Spellcasting
description: Cast Sorcerer spells using Charisma. You know 4 cantrips and prepare 2 spells of level 1. Spells that a feature always prepares do not count against these choices. Replace one prepared spell when you gain a class level. You can use a Arcane Focus as your spellcasting focus.

descriptions.2: Cast Sorcerer spells using Charisma. You know 4 cantrips and prepare 4 spells of level 1. Spells that a feature always prepares do not count against these choices. Replace one prepared spell when you gain a class level. You can use a Arcane Focus as your spellcasting focus.
descriptions.3: Cast Sorcerer spells using Charisma. You know 4 cantrips and prepare 6 spells of level 1 or 2. Spells that a feature always prepares do not count against these choices. Replace one prepared spell when you gain a class level. You can use a Arcane Focus as your spellcasting focus.

name: Font of Magic
description: Expend a spell slot to gain Sorcery Points equal to its level (no action). As a Bonus Action, create a level-1 spell slot for 2 points, or at Sorcerer level 3 a level-2 slot for 3 points. Created slots vanish after a Long Rest. You cannot exceed your Sorcery Point maximum.

name: Metamagic
description: Choose two Metamagic options from the SRD. Spend Sorcery Points as specified by an option to modify a spell you cast. Use only one option per spell unless it says otherwise. Replace one option when you gain a Sorcerer level.

name: Draconic Resilience
description: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 3, then by 1 for each further Sorcerer level. While not wearing armor, your base AC is 10 + your Dexterity and Charisma modifiers.

name: Draconic Spells
description: You always have Alter Self, Chromatic Orb, Command, and Dragon's Breath prepared. These spells do not count against your prepared spell choices.
